buildings.name: Vehicle Bay
buildings.effect: Assembles ground vehicles (survey rovers Mk I–III, mining crawlers, construction rovers) one at a time; they roll out beside it.
buildings.description: An assembly hall for ground vehicles. Order survey rovers (Mk I Scout, Mk II Surveyor, Mk III Explorer) to explore, mining crawlers to dig remote deposits and construction rovers to found new outposts on the ground. Vehicles are paid for when ordered, built one at a time, and drive out through the bay door when they're done.
